title: Qualify canonical exact Math text and safe LaTeX rendering
commitMessage: feat: qualify canonical Math text and LaTeX IR codecs

contribution.summary: Create the .NET 10 Math codecs product with an exact canonical ASCII text-to-IR grammar and display-only LaTeX for rational, polynomial, function, unit and exclusion forms. Require a compiled RED, 50 GREEN tests, eight isolated NuGet consumer probes, three local archive inspections and locked builds. Complete T1 only; open M5/W01/C01 without promoting those parents, TeX import, public packages or stable 1.0.
contribution.value: Enable independent Math consumers to exchange structurally exact, meaning-preserving mathematical expressions and safe presentation with explicit grammar limits and no provider or agent dependency.
debtChanges: Create the real dw.tools.math.codecs .NET 10 project and its test project in the existing .slnx, with explicit locked ProjectReference graphs and no source migration from other repositories.
Observe a compiled missing public parser/renderer API RED against the empty codec assembly before installing the T1 implementation and fifty independent scientific GREEN tests.
Admit a versioned canonical ASCII prefix grammar with rational exactness, x/y/z identity, bounded arithmetic/sqrt/abs, three typed quantities and retained eq/ne/ge source restrictions.
Round-trip admitted canonical text and existing Math IR JSON without lossy identities, and render only whitelisted nodes to display-only LaTeX with typed refusals and no executable commands.

Preserve guarded x/y/z IR symbol admission, then verify every positive exact-text rational is reduced (gcd=1). Admit 5463/20 for exact 27315/100 Kelvin; explicitly reject the unreduced Kelvin spelling and keep all 50 GREEN oracles.
Build the locked .NET solution and new test suite, retain exact IR/quantities regressions, and independently inspect three locally packed net10 product archives and their actual SHA-256 hashes.
Execute eight NuGet-only client oracles using one pinned codecs preview.1 package and transitive IR/quantities; keep external feeds cleared and no product ProjectReference in the consumer.
Complete only T1 RED/GREEN/verification and T1. M5/W01/C01 become in-progress while T2, LaTeX import, MathML, Office, stable 1.0 and external adoption remain untouched.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS066 success, qualify M5-W01-C01-T2 adversarial escaping, nesting, command allowlists and ambiguity without treating display-only LaTeX as an input parser.
